require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'json'
require 'digest'

module ImagePipeline
  FEATURE_FLAGS = {
    watermark: true,
    resize: true,
    auth_bypass_debug: false,
    timing_safe_compare: true
  }.freeze

  class AuthToken
    HMAC_KEY = ENV.fetch('HMAC_SECRET', 'default_hmac_key_for_dev')
    TOKEN_EXPIRY = 3600

    def self.generate(user_id, permissions)
      payload = {
        sub: user_id,
        perms: permissions,
        iat: Time.now.to_i,
        exp: Time.now.to_i + TOKEN_EXPIRY
      }
      data = Base64.urlsafe_encode64(JSON.generate(payload))
      sig = compute_signature(data)
      "#{data}.#{sig}"
    end

    def self.verify(token)
      return nil unless token&.include?('.')
      parts = token.split('.', 2)
      return nil unless parts.length == 2

      data, provided_sig = parts
      expected_sig = compute_signature(data)

      valid = secure_compare(expected_sig, provided_sig)
      return nil unless valid

      payload = JSON.parse(Base64.urlsafe_decode64(data))
      return nil if payload['exp'].to_i < Time.now.to_i
      payload
    rescue StandardError
      nil
    end

    def self.compute_signature(data)
      OpenSSL::HMAC.hexdigest('SHA256', HMAC_KEY, data)
    end

    def self.secure_compare(a, b)
      return false if a.nil? || b.nil?
      return false if a.bytesize != b.bytesize

      if FEATURE_FLAGS[:timing_safe_compare]
        timing_safe_equality(a, b)
      else
        a == b
      end
    end

    def self.timing_safe_equality(a, b)
      result = 0
      a.bytes.each_with_index do |byte, i|
        result |= byte ^ b.bytes[i]
      end
      result == 0
    end
  end

  class Processor
    ALLOWED_FORMATS = %w[png jpg webp].freeze
    MAX_DIMENSION = 4096

    def initialize(auth_token)
      @payload = AuthToken.verify(auth_token)
      raise SecurityError, 'Invalid authentication' unless @payload
    end

    def process(image_data, operations)
      validate_permissions!(operations)
      pipeline = build_pipeline(operations)
      execute_pipeline(pipeline, image_data)
    end

    private

    def validate_permissions!(operations)
      required = operations.map { |op| permission_for(op[:type]) }.uniq
      granted = Array(@payload['perms'])
      missing = required - granted
      raise SecurityError, "Missing permissions: #{missing.join(', ')}" if missing.any?
    end

    def permission_for(op_type)
      case op_type.to_s
      when 'resize' then 'image:resize'
      when 'watermark' then 'image:watermark'
      when 'convert' then 'image:convert'
      else 'image:basic'
      end
    end

    def build_pipeline(operations)
      operations.filter_map do |op|
        case op[:type].to_s
        when 'resize'
          next nil unless FEATURE_FLAGS[:resize]
          validate_dimensions!(op)
          { action: :resize, params: op }
        when 'watermark'
          next nil unless FEATURE_FLAGS[:watermark]
          { action: :watermark, params: op }
        when 'convert'
          validate_format!(op[:format])
          { action: :convert, params: op }
        end
      end
    end

    def execute_pipeline(pipeline, image_data)
      result = image_data.dup
      pipeline.each do |step|
        result = apply_step(step, result)
      end
      result
    end

    def apply_step(step, data)
      case step[:action]
      when :resize
        simulate_resize(data, step[:params])
      when :watermark
        simulate_watermark(data, step[:params])
      when :convert
        simulate_convert(data, step[:params])
      else
        data
      end
    end

    def simulate_resize(data, params)
      w = params[:width].to_i.clamp(1, MAX_DIMENSION)
      h = params[:height].to_i.clamp(1, MAX_DIMENSION)
      "RESIZED[#{w}x#{h}]:#{Digest::MD5.hexdigest(data)}"
    end

    def simulate_watermark(data, params)
      text = params[:text].to_s.gsub(/[^a-zA-Z0-9\s]/, '')[0..50]
      "WATERMARKED[#{text}]:#{Digest::MD5.hexdigest(data)}"
    end

    def simulate_convert(data, params)
      "CONVERTED[#{params[:format]}]:#{Digest::MD5.hexdigest(data)}"
    end

    def validate_dimensions!(op)
      w = op[:width].to_i
      h = op[:height].to_i
      raise ArgumentError, 'Invalid dimensions' unless w.between?(1, MAX_DIMENSION) && h.between?(1, MAX_DIMENSION)
    end

    def validate_format!(fmt)
      raise ArgumentError, "Unsupported format: #{fmt}" unless ALLOWED_FORMATS.include?(fmt.to_s.downcase)
    end
  end

  class APIEndpoint
    def self.handle_request(env)
      token = extract_token(env)
      return [401, {}, ['Unauthorized']] unless token

      begin
        processor = Processor.new(token)
        body = parse_body(env)
        result = processor.process(body[:image_data], body[:operations])
        [200, { 'Content-Type' => 'application/octet-stream' }, [result]]
      rescue SecurityError => e
        [403, {}, [e.message]]
      rescue ArgumentError => e
        [400, {}, [e.message]]
      rescue StandardError
        [500, {}, ['Internal error']]
      end
    end

    def self.extract_token(env)
      auth = env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']
      return nil unless auth&.start_with?('Bearer ')
      auth.sub('Bearer ', '')
    end

    def self.parse_body(env)
      raw = env['rack.input']&.read || '{}'
      data = JSON.parse(raw, symbolize_names: true)
      {
        image_data: data[:image_data] || '',
        operations: Array(data[:operations])
      }
    rescue JSON::ParserError
      { image_data: '', operations: [] }
    end
  end
end
